name: Crimson Ledger: daily murder-mystery logic puzzles
description: Crimson Ledger is a murder-mystery logic puzzle made in the Netherlands, in Dutch and English. Each case is a floor plan with suspects, rooms and furniture. Players place every suspect from their statements and unmask the one person who was alone with the victim. Every case is generated and checked by our own engine: exactly one solution, reachable by pure logic, never by guessing. Hints teach the next deduction instead of giving the answer away, and a guided practice case teaches the rules in a minute. Version 1.1 adds a daily case with a streak that unlocks gift worlds at 7 and 30 days. No ads; the first 96 cases are free.
notes: Independent app by a single developer in the Netherlands. Version 1.1 is live since 3 October 2026; 1.1.1 (store language fix) follows. Strongest in the Netherlands and Belgium (Dutch), also fully playable in English.
